# Operations

Every SDK call names one of these operations. The gate refuses a call whose level is above the client's
cap before any request is made. Levels and risks are explained in [LEVELS.md](LEVELS.md).

## Provider API

| Operation | Level | Risk | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `capabilities` | L2 | read | `GET /capabilities` | Server limits and features |
| `health` | L2 | read | `GET /health` | Checks that the key works |
| `usage` | L2 | read | `GET /usage` | Bytes used, quota, object count and change sequence |
| `blobs.put` | L2 | write | `PUT /blobs/{id}` | Store one blob |
| `blobs.get` | L2 | read | `GET /blobs/{id}` | Read one blob |
| `blobs.head` | L2 | read | `HEAD /blobs/{id}` | Size and checksum of one blob |
| `blobs.list` | L2 | read | `GET /blobs` | List blob ids |
| `blobs.batchHas` | L2 | read | `POST /blobs/batch-has` | Which of these blobs exist |
| `blobs.delete` | L3 | destructive | `DELETE /blobs/{id}` | Delete one blob |
| `manifests.get` | L2 | read | `GET /manifests/{key}` | Read one manifest |
| `manifests.put` | L2 | write | `PUT /manifests/{key}` | Write one manifest (create-only or compare-and-swap) |
| `manifests.list` | L2 | read | `GET /manifests` | List manifest keys and generations |
| `manifests.delete` | L3 | destructive | `DELETE /manifests/{key}` | Delete one manifest |
| `keyEnvelope.get` | L2 | read | `GET /key-envelope` | Read the wrapped master key |
| `keyEnvelope.create` | L2 | key | `PUT /key-envelope` | Create the master key and its recovery envelope (only when none exists) |
| `keyEnvelope.replace` | L3 | key | `PUT /key-envelope` | Replace the recovery envelope of an existing master key (passphrase change or re-wrap) |
| `apiKey.rotate` | L2 | credential | `POST /connect/rotate` | Replace this binding's API key |
| `share.createReadKey` | L3 | sharing | `POST /keys` | Mint a read-only key for this binding |
| `share.listReadKeys` | L2 | read | `GET /keys` | List this binding's read-only keys |
| `share.revokeReadKey` | L3 | sharing | `DELETE /keys/{keyId}` | Revoke a read-only key |

## Files, sync, sharing and events

| Operation | Level | Risk | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crypto.unlock` | L2 | key | (local) | Unwrap the master key with the recovery passphrase, in memory |
| `crypto.importMasterKey` | L2 | key | (local) | Use a master key handed over by the host (for example the Rotten Apple launcher) |
| `crypto.exportMasterKey` | L4 | key-export | (local) | Return the raw master key to the caller |
| `files.list` | L2 | read | (composite) | List a folder |
| `files.stat` | L2 | read | (composite) | Metadata of one file |
| `files.read` | L2 | read | (composite) | Read a file |
| `files.write` | L2 | write | (composite) | Create or replace a file |
| `files.mkdir` | L2 | write | (composite) | Create a folder |
| `files.move` | L2 | write | (composite) | Rename or move a file or folder |
| `files.delete` | L3 | destructive | (composite) | Delete one file or an empty folder |
| `files.deleteSlot` | L2 | destructive | (composite) | Delete one save slot: a single file directly inside the app's save folder |
| `files.deleteFolder` | L3 | bulk-destructive | (composite) | Delete a folder and everything in it |
| `files.collectGarbage` | L3 | bulk-destructive | (composite) | Delete blobs no file references |
| `sync.push` | L2 | write | (composite) | Upload new and changed local files |
| `sync.pull` | L2 | write | (composite) | Download new and changed remote files to the local folder |
| `sync.mirror` | L3 | bulk-destructive | (composite) | Make one side identical to the other, deleting extras |
| `share.createIdentity` | L2 | key | (local) | Create a recipient key pair for receiving shares |
| `share.export` | L3 | sharing | (composite) | Encrypt one file's key to a recipient |
| `share.open` | L2 | read | (composite) | Open a share addressed to this recipient |
| `events.watch` | L2 | read | (composite) | Poll for manifest changes, usage changes and revocation |
| `storage.wipe` | L4 | bulk-destructive | (composite) | Delete every object stored through this binding |

## Connect

| Operation | Level | Risk | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `connect.redeemGrant` | L2 | credential | `POST /connect/redeem` | Exchange a one-time connect code for an API key |
| `connect.exchangeCode` | L2 | credential | `POST /connect/token` | Exchange a PKCE authorization code for an API key |

## Account (signed-in user)

| Operation | Level | Risk | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account.createGrant` | L3 | sharing | `POST /connect/grants` | Issue a one-time connect code for a workspace |
| `account.authorize` | L3 | sharing | `POST /connect/authorize` | Approve a PKCE connect request |
| `account.listBindings` | L2 | read | `GET /bindings` | List connected apps |
| `account.revokeBinding` | L3 | sharing | `DELETE /bindings/{id}` | Disconnect an app, keeping its data |
| `account.revokeAndDelete` | L4 | bulk-destructive | `DELETE /bindings/{id}?deleteData=true` | Disconnect an app and delete its data |

## Teams (signed-in user)

| Operation | Level | Risk | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `teams.catalog` | L2 | read | `GET /v2/teams/catalog` | Team tiers, Enterprise contact and the color palette |
| `teams.list` | L2 | read | `GET /v2/teams` | Teams the account belongs to |
| `teams.create` | L3 | billing | `POST /v2/teams` | Create a team and open its subscription checkout |
| `teams.get` | L2 | read | `GET /v2/teams/{id}` | A team, its members and the color choices |
| `teams.checkout` | L3 | billing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/checkout` | Resume or replace the team subscription checkout |
| `teams.createInvite` | L3 | sharing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/invites` | Create an invite code |
| `teams.revokeInvite` | L3 | sharing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/invites/{inviteId}/revoke` | Revoke an invite code |
| `teams.previewInvite` | L2 | read | `POST /v2/teams/join/preview` | Team name, size and free colors for an invite code |
| `teams.join` | L3 | sharing | `POST /v2/teams/join` | Join a team with an invite code |
| `teams.updateMe` | L2 | write | `PATCH /v2/teams/{id}/me` | Change your display name or color in a team |
| `teams.leave` | L3 | destructive | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/leave` | Leave a team; your shares are removed |
| `teams.workspaces` | L2 | read | `GET /v2/teams/{id}/workspaces` | Team workspaces and shared personal workspaces |
| `teams.createWorkspace` | L3 | billing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/workspaces` | Create a team workspace and open its plans checkout |
| `teams.checkoutWorkspace` | L3 | billing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/workspaces/{wid}/checkout` | Resume a team workspace's plans checkout |
| `teams.share` | L3 | sharing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/shares` | Show one of your personal workspaces to the team (view only) |
| `teams.unshare` | L3 | sharing | `DELETE /v2/teams/{id}/shares/{wid}` | Stop showing a personal workspace to the team |
| `teams.chat.list` | L2 | read | `GET /v2/teams/{id}/chat` | Chat messages after a sequence number |
| `teams.chat.watch` | L2 | read | `GET /v2/teams/{id}/chat` | Poll for new chat messages |
| `teams.chat.post` | L2 | write | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/chat` | Post a text message or a workspace card |
| `teams.chat.report` | L2 | write | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/chat/{seq}/report` | Report a message to the platform |
| `teams.chat.delete` | L3 | destructive | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/chat/{seq}/delete` | Remove a message (owner, reason required) |
| `teams.members.mute` | L3 | destructive | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/members/{memberId}/mute` | Mute a member (owner, reason required) |
| `teams.members.unmute` | L3 | write | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/members/{memberId}/unmute` | Unmute a member (owner) |
| `teams.members.kick` | L3 | destructive | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/members/{memberId}/kick` | Remove a member (owner, reason required) |
| `teams.members.ban` | L3 | destructive | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/members/{memberId}/ban` | Remove a member and block rejoining (owner, reason required) |
| `teams.members.setRole` | L3 | sharing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/members/{memberId}/role` | Make a member a viewer or a full member (owner) |
| `teams.audit` | L2 | read | `GET /v2/teams/{id}/audit` | The team's hash-chained audit log (owner) |
| `teams.transfer` | L4 | sharing | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/transfer` | Hand the team to another member (owner) |
| `teams.delete` | L4 | bulk-destructive | `POST /v2/teams/{id}/delete` | Delete the team, its chat and its team workspaces with their files (owner) |
